title: Portable worker task and receipt, version 1
description: Proposed W8 contract. Root accepts a shared task or a receipt. $defs/seat_grant is a separately authorized scheduling envelope, never inserted into or used to mutate a portable task. All objects are closed. Cross-document identity, byte budgets, resource comparisons, freshness, replay, actual isolation, and file contents require a trusted host verifier; JSON Schema alone cannot establish them. Canonical task/grant bytes are UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon, no insignificant whitespace, no trailing newline, and no non-integer JSON numbers. Unknown keywords in the accompanying strict stdlib validator are errors, not ignored. AMEND AW8 (v1 pre-acceptance revision): nested .git refused at any depth; storage/isolation observations bound on failures; cleanup_success required whenever a local capsule was observed and rc != 6; rc 7 split into operator_recipe/operator_capability; optional verbatim bridge-task-v1 embedding; A1 image_tag/env_recipe_sha256 and env_image; A2 speech_act; A3 nesting and scheduler_lease. AMEND3 (A4 operator security baseline): one hardened base image + per-task tmpfs clone of the verified commit; no per-commit images; tar-over-exec text extract; inference host-only.

no_host_mounts.description: A4.2: zero host bind mounts. Writable: capsule tmpfs only; the cache volume is read-only to tasks.
